definitions.explanation: A small medical facility with fewer than 20 beds (or no inpatient beds at all), as defined by Japanese medical law. Smaller than a hospital, typically run by a single doctor or small group of doctors for outpatient care.

examples.japanese: {近|ちか}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{診療所|しんりょうじょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{診|み}て→診る：09798_miru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I was seen at a nearby clinic.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{島|しま}→島：00885_shima⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧、⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧{診療所|しんりょうじょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧だ。
examples.english: There is no hospital on this island — just one small clinic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{診療所|しんりょうじょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{閉鎖|へいさ}→閉鎖：14524_heisa⟧⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{遠|とお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}わなければ→通う：01217_kayou⟧⟦ならなく→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The local clinic was closed, and residents had to travel to a distant hospital.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{歯科|しか}→歯科：11072_shika⟧{診療所|しんりょうじょ}: dental clinic
- ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{診療所|しんりょうじょ}: local/community clinic
- {無床|むしょう}{診療所|しんりょうじょ}: clinic without inpatient beds

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧: hospital (20+ beds, by legal definition in Japan)
- ⟦クリニック→クリニック：08941_kurinikku⟧: clinic (loanword, commonly used in clinic names)
- ⟦{医院|いいん}→医院：01778_iin⟧: medical practice, doctor's office (commonly used in clinic names)

USAGE:
In Japanese medical law, {診療所|しんりょうじょ} is legally distinct from ⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧: a {診療所|しんりょうじょ} has fewer than 20 beds, while a ⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧ has 20 or more. In everyday language, people often say ⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧ for any medical facility, but {診療所|しんりょうじょ} specifically refers to smaller clinics.
